SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.welcome.title: The Ancients talk now
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.welcome.body: Ancient events have a Talk option, and the shop has a Talk button. They remember you, ask things of you, and give you a keepsake that grows with the friendship.
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.talk.title: Talk
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.talk.body:
Ancient events have a Talk option at the bottom; in the shop, Talk is in the top-right corner. 3 lines per visit, and what you say changes affection: hostile, stranger, friendly, close, devoted.

With the AI you can type your own words; with the written lines you pick one of three replies.

NPCs remember earlier runs. Memories in the settings lets you read, edit or add notes.
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.deals.title: Deals
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.deals.body:
Sometimes an NPC asks for something, like "reach act 2 alive". Choose the deal to accept.

An accepted deal shows up as a relic. Hover it for the terms and your progress.

Kept: the relic leaves, affection +6, gold +50. Broken: the relic greys out until the run ends.
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.keepsakes.title: Keepsakes
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.keepsakes.body:
After one talk, an NPC gives you their keepsake. Not while they are hostile.

It is a relic whose level follows affection: stranger I, friendly II, close III, devoted turns it into a vow. It never goes down.

Each deal you keep engraves it and raises its numbers.
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.road.title: Road and shop
SPIRETALK-MSG.Guide.road.body:
Up to two special events per run: the overturned cart, and an Ancient by the road.

Help the Merchant and you get The Merchant's Favour: 15% off at the next shop. Take his goods and you get The Merchant's Grudge: every shop costs 15% more this run.

An Ancient who likes you may put one of their own relics up for sale in the shop.

SPIRETALK-MSG.RegionChinaDesc: Sign-up needs a phone number and ID
SPIRETALK-MSG.KeyStepsChina:
1. Open the link below, sign up and sign in to the Zhipu open platform (phone number and ID check).
2. On the API Keys page, add a new key and copy it.
3. Paste it in the box below and press Test. The free model is picked for you.
SPIRETALK-MSG.KeyStepsAbroad:
1. Open the link below and sign in to AI Studio with a Google account.
2. Press Create API key and copy it.
3. Paste it in the box below and press Test. The free model is picked for you.
